summary: Iteration-4 testing: All iter-3 backend features (publish-guard, AND/OR group rules, nested groups, round-trip persistence) verified end-to-end. 43/43 backend tests PASS (100%) including iter-1 + iter-2 regression. Frontend: indigo accent visible on login page (submit + hero gradient), dashboard sidebar active state indigo, workflows list correctly disables 'اجرا' for drafts and enables for published (with تنخواه/مرخصی showing emerald منتشر شده badges and nl/آنبوردینگ showing amber پیش‌نویس badges), published-flow start works and emits success toast 'نمونه فرایند آغاز شد', JalaliDatePicker rendered in FormBuilder live preview with Persian placeholder 'تاریخ را انتخاب کنید…'.

ui_bugs.issue: Native HTML disabled attribute prevents onClick from firing, so the toast.error('ابتدا فرایند را منتشر کنید') guard inside start() is unreachable via real user click. The disabled state already prevents the action and the title='ابتدا منتشر کنید' tooltip provides feedback, so UX is intact. Cosmetic redundancy only — consider removing the disabled prop and relying on the JS guard if a toast on click is required.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Either remove `disabled={w.status !== 'published'}` from the اجرا button so the JS guard's toast.error fires on click, OR drop the toast guard since it is unreachable. Either path is fine; the current dual-protection is harmless.

Frontend testing not exhaustive: I did not exercise the new RuleEditor promoteToGroup AND/OR UI in FormBuilder inspector, nor the WorkflowBuilder onNodeDragStop auto-save and topbar اجرا guard. The backing engine + API are fully proven by test_iter3.py; the FE wiring should be self-verified by main agent or in next iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.evaluate_rule cleanly recurses for {combinator, conditions} groups — verified for AND, OR, nested AND-inside-OR, empty conditions, and backwards-compat single clauses. Logic short-circuits correctly (any/all).
Pydantic VisibilityRule with all-optional fields accepts both shapes. Round-trip via POST → GET → PATCH → GET preserves combinator and nested conditions exactly.

POST /api/workflows/{id}/start now correctly raises 400 with detail='workflow_not_published' when status != 'published'. After PATCH status='published', returns 200 with {process, advanced} including next_tasks.

E2E AND-group edge: when manager approves with amount=8M → engine picks the conditional edge to n4 (admin). With amount=1M → engine falls through to the default edge (n5 payment), correctly skipping n4. OR-group: amount=1M but manager-approved → engine still picks conditional edge.
Iter-1 + Iter-2 suite (auth, dashboard, forms, tasks, comments, processes, AI SSE, conditional edges, tabs forms, engine E2E above/below/rejection) all green — no regressions.
Minor (carried-over, not iter-3 regression): WorkflowsList disabled اجرا button blocks both action AND the toast.error guard inside start(). Tooltip handles UX but the JS toast path is dead code.
